embeds.title: Forever Sixty commands
embeds.description:
**/raid** Your guild's next raid. Sign up from the answer.
**/signup** Sign up for a raid without the post.
**/char** A character: item level, readiness and the top 3 upgrades.
**/bis** Best in slot for a class and spec.
**/report** The last logged raid: kills and loot.
**/attendance** Your attendance. Officers can name anyone.
**/readiness** Officers: who is not ready for the next raid.
**/link** Link this Discord account to Forever Sixty.
**/help** This list.
